# TwitterShots

> TwitterShots is a free web tool for creating beautiful Twitter/X screenshots and PDFs. It preserves tweet formatting including threads, quoted posts, polls and media while offering customizable themes and mobile optimization. You can integrate the Screenshot API into your app or workflow for automated screenshot generation.

Key features include:
- Instant conversion from Tweet URLs
- Thread unrolling into images/PDFs
- Customizable templates and branding removal (Pro)
- Mobile-first design with Apple Shortcuts integration
- AI translation
- Automation with n8n and Zapier integration

Keywords: customize tweet screenshot, twitter screenshot theme, tweet image aspect ratio, X screenshot dark mode

Customize logo image, brand text, font color, size, weight, and alignment. Perfect for professional social media content and marketing materials. Pro+ feature.
